user.title: Connect to EcoEdge
user.description: Sign in with your EcoEdge account to enable AI-powered predictive heating control. The receiver endpoint is determined automatically.

data_description.api_base: Leave as is unless EcoEdge support gave you another address (staging or self-hosted).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate EcoEdge
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {email} is no longer valid. Enter your EcoEdge password to reconnect.

error.invalid_config: Invalid configuration; please verify your input and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the EcoEdge service. Check your internet connection.
error.auth_request_failed: Authentication failed. Please try again or contact info@ecoedge.io.

abort.unknown_entry: Configuration entry could not be found.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Settings updated successfully. The integration is reloading to apply your changes.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-authentication successful. The integration has reconnected.

user.title: EcoEdge AI Thermostat settings
user.description: Update your thermostat selection or rotate the access token. Provide your password only if you want to issue a new token.

error.invalid_config: Invalid configuration; please verify your input and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the EcoEdge service. Check your internet connection.
error.auth_request_failed: Authentication failed. Please try again or contact info@ecoedge.io.

yaml_deprecated.title: EcoEdge YAML configuration is deprecated
yaml_deprecated.description: The `ha_ecoedge_ai_thermostat:` block in `configuration.yaml` stores your EcoEdge password in plain text. Set the integration up under **Settings → Devices & services** (an existing setup keeps working), then remove the block from `configuration.yaml` and restart Home Assistant. YAML support will be removed in a future release.

outdated.title: EcoEdge AI Thermostat needs an update
outdated.description: You are running version {version}, but EcoEdge now needs at least {min_version}. Update the integration in HACS and restart Home Assistant, otherwise uploads or sensors may stop working.

backend_unreachable.title: EcoEdge has been unreachable for {hours} hours
backend_unreachable.description: Home Assistant could not deliver readings to EcoEdge or load the AI profiles for more than a day. Readings are kept for up to 24 hours (5,000 readings) and sent once EcoEdge is reachable again. Check the internet connection of this Home Assistant. This issue clears itself after the next successful upload.

readings_at_risk.title: EcoEdge readings will be dropped soon
readings_at_risk.description: {pending} of at most {max} readings are waiting for EcoEdge, and the oldest has waited {hours} hours. Readings older than 24 hours, or above the limit, are dropped. This issue clears itself once the backlog has been delivered.

readings_dropped.title: Some EcoEdge readings were dropped
readings_dropped.description: Readings could not be delivered and were dropped: {overflow} because EcoEdge was unreachable for too long (24 hours or 5,000 readings), {rejected} because EcoEdge rejected them. The counts are totals since the integration was set up. This issue clears itself after a day without new drops; the details are in the diagnostics download.
